title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our growing AI team. You will design and build production-grade LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic systems using cutting-edge tools.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and implement LLM-powered applications using LangChain, OpenAI, and Azure OpenAI
- Build scalable RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines with vector databases (Pinecone, Azure AI Search)
- Develop and deploy ML models using Python, PyTorch, and HuggingFace
- Integrate AI solutions with existing enterprise systems via REST APIs and FastAPI
- Work with Power Platform and Microsoft Copilot Studio for business automation
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams using Agile/Scrum methodology
- Monitor and optimize model performance in production environments

Requirements:
- 2+ years of experience with Python and machine learning
- Strong knowledge of LangChain, OpenAI API, Azure AI Services
- Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate)
- Proficiency in FastAPI or Django for API development
- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
- Knowledge of prompt engineering and fine-tuning techniques
- Experience with NLP libraries: spaCy, HuggingFace Transformers
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills
- Experience with Azure or AWS cloud platforms

Bonus:
- Microsoft Certifications (AI-900, DP-100)
- Experience with Copilot Studio or Power Automate
- Knowledge of semantic search and embeddings
